verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes spelling validation as an acceptance condition for generated images before they are added to book documents.
The client specifies that generated-image spelling validation must occur during image generation rather than proofreading.
The client defines the image-validation acceptance flow: inspect every image, regenerate images with spelling errors, and insert only validated images into the document.
This is a target-specific implementation claim that the completed Ontario book images were checked; it does not independently verify that every image passed spelling validation.
